autonomy_claim: Not certified: full M2M and autonomous operation requires capability-scoped evidence across every implementation repository and lab.

gaps.gap: A single executable cross-repository M2M handshake, audience/scope enforcement, rotation, revocation, and replay test is not evidenced in the canonical repository.
gaps.acceptance: Negative-path integration tests reject expired, wrong-audience, wrong-scope, replayed, revoked, and malformed signed messages.

gaps.gap: The control-plane architecture is documented, but durable autonomous run evidence with leases, retries, compensation, reconciliation, pause, and kill-switch behavior is not present in this baseline.
gaps.acceptance: A clean-state lab executes a run through restart, duplicate delivery, timeout, retry, compensation, reconciliation, pause, and resume with an auditable run ID.

gaps.gap: Signing and attestation are documented as beta/conditional; value-bearing autonomous settlement must remain disabled until the current acceptance audit is closed.
gaps.acceptance: Production-boundary checks fail closed when signing, attestation, oracle, policy, or settlement evidence is absent.

gaps.gap: The full lab dependency manifest, preflight, reproducible execution path, and evidence capture are not yet canonicalized.
gaps.acceptance: A documented runner validates toolchains, networks, credentials, fixtures, safety limits, expected outputs, teardown, and emits immutable evidence without fabricated success.

gaps.gap: The Vercel production project has no configured admin runtime base URL, and deployment protection prevents anonymous live endpoint verification.
gaps.acceptance: Production and preview environments expose the canonical runtime URL, authenticated health/readiness checks pass, and approved test-mode read/write operations produce auditable evidence.

gaps.gap: Readiness language and implementation evidence are distributed across historical reports, requiring an automated contradiction and freshness gate.
gaps.acceptance: CI validates the ledger schema, status vocabulary, dates, evidence paths, and blocks unsupported blanket autonomy or production claims.
